notes.title: WARCANA Patch 4 is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534244/8f1a7f49466c14f36e8d45132d877afbfe70d684.png[/img]

[h3]We're back with [b]Patch 4[/b] for WARCANA! But that's not all! We're happy to announce that the [b]Single Player Demo[/b] is back![/h3]

This patch is focused on balancing the game based on player feedback, as well as fixing a number of bugs! 

[b]Here's the TL;DR:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Single Player Demo is back, with 10 campaign missions to play through!
[*] Fine-tuned the Battle Royale turn timings
[*] Added 10 new prebuild decks
[*] All hand cards now get discarded at the end of the round
[*] Tons of balancing and bug fixes!
[/list]
 
[h2]New Features and General Improvements[/h2]
- New Unit: Lykonian Brood
- New Barracks: Breeding Pool
- Different cards that do the same actions now have the description text in the same order
- Add 10 new prebuild decks
- All hand cards now get discarded at the end of the round
- The system for increasing wall costs is now explained in the tutorial
- Fay Calling devotion description updated to remove false claim that units regenerate HP from faction perk

[h2]Balancing Changes[/h2]
[b]Battle Royale Changes[/b]
- Changed Turn Timings:
Turn 0 - Total: 70 - Peaceful: 50 - Battle: 20
Turn 1 - Total: 80 - Peaceful: 45 - Battle: 35
Turn 2 - Total: 90 - Peaceful: 40 - Battle: 50
Turn 3 - Total: 100 - Peaceful: 35 - Battle: 65

[b]Scenario Changes[/b]
- Life and Death: Added 7 Crystal Labs on Player Island
- Burial: Adjusted Artillery placement

[h2]Fixed Issues[/h2]
- Fixed post-game screen displaying wrong player rank at the top
- Fixed a typo in the French localisation for Economy buildings
- Fixed 'single use' text showing outside the draw/discard pile while scrolling
- Updated the rank overview screen in the profile with correct division names for alternate ranks
- Players can no longer go up or down more than one rank in a single game
- Replays now correctly play back the game after a player disconnects
- It is no longer possible to remove cards in deckbuilding screen while the devotion overview is open
- Fixed building range not displaying when hovering over a building while paused
- It is no longer possible to watch replays while in the multiplayer queue
- The tech tree can no longer be scrolled from outside the window
- Unit tooltips no longer flicker when the game is paused, and are now hidden
- Card will no longer be highlighted in the main menu after leaving a campaign mission with a highlighted card
- Fixed a rare bug where cards would get stuck on the hand after being played

[i]Please note: Due to these changes, old replays are now incompatible.[/i]

[b]Please continue to send us over your feedback and thoughts as you play through the new patch![/b]

notes.title: WARCANA Patch 3 is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534244/cd56d443038998f437f5bebe5bb875ef64dd3644.png[/img]

[h3][b]Hello again![/b][/h3]
 
[h3]We're back with our third post-launch patch for WARCANA![/h3]

Once again, thank you for all of your feedback! We hope that this series of patches has made the game a lot more enjoyable for you!

[b]Here's the TL;DR for this patch:[/b]
[list]
[*] Main Building is immune to Attack Spells!
[*] New controls for power players!
[*] Pause Button in Single Player
[*] Bigger Smite with charges
[*] Wall balancing
[*] Devotion balancing changes
[*] Small campaign improvements
[*] Lots of bug fixes
[/list]
 
[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[b]Interface-Setting:[/b]
- “Set card animation speed” option added
[b]Controls:[/b]
- Use keys 1,2,3,4 for Card/Building choice picks
- Use keys Q & E to switch between islands
- Use Spacebar to pause/unpause in single player
- Smite is now bound to Ctrl
 
[h2]General Improvements[/h2]
[b]UI:[/b]
- Cards now display the string "Single use" if they are single use cards
- Pause button in the top menu now works in Single Player. Hold it to fast-forward
- Improved visual feedback when selecting a building variant or making a card choice

[h2]General Balancing[/h2]
[b]Main Building[/b]
- Is now immune to Attack Spells!
[b]Smite[/b]
- Charges: every 3s -> 2x round number,
- Hotkey: Space -> Ctrl L & R,
- Size: 2x2 -> 5x5
[b]Walls[/b]
- Starting at 200 Walls: Wall cost increases by 1, increases further for each 100 additional Walls

[h2]Devotion Balancing[/h2]
[h3]Occultism[/h3]
[b]Crystal Crush:[/b]
- Card cost: 1 Mana -> 2 Mana
[b]Noble Demon:[/b]
- Wall damage 5 -> 2
- Health: 25 -> 15

[h3]Fay Calling[/h3]
[b]Forest Biotope:[/b]
- Card cost: 40 Structure -> 25 Structure
[b]Ancient Warden:[/b]
- Attack Damage: 32/s -> 26/s

[h3]Current Weaving[/h3]
[b]Mana Cistern:[/b]
- Building-variant: Provides From the Deep on First Survive -> Provides From the Deep on Survive
[b]From the Deep:[/b]
- Card: Permanent -> Single Use
- Card cost: 2 -> 3 Mana
[b]Spectral Stream: [/b]
- provides Binding Tencales on first survive -> on survive
[b]Binding Tentacles:[/b]
- Card: Pemanent -> Single use
[b]Underwater Spring:[/b] 
- provide Turn the Tide on first survive -> on survive
[b]Treasure Vault:[/b] 
- provide Storm Tide on first survive -> on survive
[b]Storm Tide:[/b]
- Card: Pemanent -> Single use
[b]Permanent Turn the Tide:[/b]
- Card: Shuffle Discard pile back was removed

[h3]Technomancy[/h3]
[b]Technomancy Perk Trait:[/b]
- Technomancy Health gain per round: 10hp ->25hp
[b]BLASTER Alpha & Beta:[/b]
- Wall Damage: 6/s -> 12/s
[b]BREACHER Alpha & Beta:[/b]
- Health: 100 -> 220
- Speed: 100px/s -> 130px/s
[b]Annihilator:[/b]
- Explosion impact area: 150 pixels -> 220 pixels

[h3]Void Forging[/h3]
[b]Black Hole:[/b]
- Duration: 3s -> 6s

[h2]Campaign Improvements[/h2]
- Campaign messages can be closed with Space, Return and Esc as well!
- Arrival (Tutorial)
- Flow improved
- Text changes
- Swarm intelligence in single player missions adjusted to work with balance changes

[h2]Fixed Issues[/h2]
- Main Building health bars now update immediately
- Attack Spells and Tower Lasers no longer remain after someone has died
- Flying card animations no longer block input
- Auto spawns triggered by buildings now always appear in the spawn list
- Card destruction effects are now only played for cards visible on screen
- Camera can now be moved with WASD, even when hovering over UI or Cards
- Improved German translation of the Arrival (Tutorial)
- F2 no longer accelerates animations in Multiplayer matches
- The game no longer crashes when trying to build more than 4096 buildings/walls. Once 4000 buildings have been placed, building walls is disabled. Once 4096 buildings have been placed, no more buildings can be built.
- Fixed wall segments not being built at exactly maximum length
- Fixed a crash when continuing a save from the “A Free Meal” DLC scenario
- Placed the spell preview grid on the same height as spell outlines
- Added missing translation for the ‘locked’ campaign button
- Fixed a bug where the attack patterns of towers were inverted

[i]Please note: Due to these changes, old replays are now incompatible.[/i]

[b]Please continue to send us over your feedback and thoughts as you play through the new patch![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2022930/WARCANA/

notes.title: New WARCANA Release Date - 29th August
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534244/3ffab6343cd935cdddc023f3e52a5833d6dededc.png[/img]

How’s it going everyone?

We’ve got some important (and maybe slightly disappointing) news to share with you today. WARCANA’s original launch date was set to be the 15th August, however following the demo and player feedback, we’ve decided to push the launch date back by a couple of weeks to [b]29th August[/b].

The main reason for this slight delay is that we’re upgrading to dedicated online servers instead of the peer-to-peer connections we were using in the demo. This will increase WARCANA’s network reliability and improve the online game experience for you all, but it does take time to get there.

At the end of the day, we want our players to have a good multiplayer experience at launch and don’t want network issues to get in the way!

We know this will be disappointing news, but we look forward to meeting you all on the battlefield on 29th August!

- The 1000 Orks Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2022930/WARCANA/
